name: Cua
description: Infrastructure for computer-use agents: sandboxed desktops, a desktop driver, VM tooling and benchmarks that any agent can plug into.
whatItDoes: Provides isolated desktop environments and a driver that lets an AI agent see the screen and control mouse and keyboard safely. It serves teams building or evaluating computer-use agents on macOS, Linux and Windows guests.
howItWorks: A CLI creates sandboxes and runs commands or screenshots inside them, while a driver component exposes desktop control through a CLI, an SDK and an MCP server. Virtual machines are managed by the bundled VM tooling, and a benchmark suite measures agent performance. The core is MIT licensed; the separate desktop app carries a source-available licence.

requirements.name: macOS, Linux or Windows host
requirements.description: Host for the CLI and sandboxes

requirements.name: Agent model access
requirements.description: Credentials for whichever agent or model you attach

models: Bring your own agent; vendor computer-use models also offered
